name: Guardian Angels
overview: Scripture reveals that God appoints angels as ministering spirits to protect and serve His people, especially those who fear Him and are heirs of salvation, as seen in Psalms 34:7 and Hebrews 1:14. These guardian angels are given charge to watch over believers in all their ways, providing divine protection and care (Psalms 91:11). Jesus affirms their special attention to children, indicating their ongoing presence and ministry in heaven (Matthew 18:10). Additionally, Hebrews 13:2 warns believers to be open to the possibility of encountering angels in unexpected ways, while Jude 1:6 reminds us that not all angels remain faithful, underscoring the importance of trusting in God's sovereign oversight.
